description: This source file defines data structures and logic for managing session data within an application, including session records, lists, token statistics, and loading mechanisms from a remote source, tailored for a macOS environment using SwiftUI.

classes.name: GatewaySessionDefaultsRecord
classes.description: Represents default session configuration, including model identifier and context tokens.

classes.name: GatewaySessionEntryRecord
classes.description: Represents individual session entry data received from the server, including metadata like key, display name, provider, timestamps, and token counts.

classes.name: GatewaySessionsListResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the server response containing a list of session entries, along with metadata like timestamp, path, and defaults.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Stores token usage statistics for a session and provides formatted summaries.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Models a session in the application's UI with relevant metadata, computed properties for display, and categorization.

classes.name: SessionKind
classes.description: Enumerates session types with associated labels and colors for UI representation.

classes.name: SessionDefaults
classes.description: Stores default settings for sessions including model and context tokens.

classes.name: SessionLoadError
classes.description: Defines possible errors during session loading, with descriptive error messages.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of session data including file path, defaults, and session entries.

classes.name: SessionLoader
classes.description: Contains static methods for asynchronously loading and processing session data from a remote source.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches session data from a remote API, decodes the JSON response, and returns a structured snapshot containing session rows.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Convenience method to asynchronously load only the session rows.

methods.name: standardize
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to an absolute path, expanding tildes and removing redundant slashes.
